authorization: Jovi authorized Analyzer MCP hash validation, receipt/manifest contract, tests, related Agent memory, and reports only.

frozen_negative_evidence.preservation: Keep both receipts, quarantine copies, Gateway logs, sessions, and old reports unchanged.

required_contract.receipt_expected_hash: Use receipt stored_sha256 as the stored-copy security field; legacy sha256/source_sha256 are secondary consistency fields.
required_contract.normalization: Require exactly 64 hexadecimal characters and normalize to lowercase before comparison.
required_contract.actual_file_read: Recompute SHA-256 from stored_path; never trust UI prefix, manifest summary, source-only hash, base64, or raw inbound path.
required_contract.path_binding: Receipt path, stored path, message_id, attachment_index, trusted root, and stored copy must bind exactly.
required_contract.TOCTOU: Stat/hash and stability checks must remain enforced before analysis.

allowed_behavior: Fix stored hash comparison and error classification.
Reject source/stored mismatch, changed stored file, wrong receipt, and wrong attachment.
Keep idempotent already_analyzed behavior and GPU-lock ordering.
prohibited_changes: Router durable model or intent-gate policy (owned by CR 011)
tools.media scope, Agent count, Binding, target consumer, Cron, OAuth
Gateway port, OpenClaw core source, P0 Gate, PROJECT_STATUS.yaml, P1
model download, new dependency, lark-cli outbound, commit/tag/push
rollback: Restore only 012-touched Analyzer/receipt source and tests; preserve all live failure evidence and quarantine artifacts.
planned_runtime_action: No restart unless the final integrated tool schema requires it; total task budget allows at most one planned restart shared with CR 011.
acceptance: The existing 64-character uppercase receipt hash passes after canonical lowercase normalization.
All malformed, mismatch, wrong-path, changed-file, and source/stored-negative cases fail closed.
Analyzer output records receipt_expected_hash and analyzer_computed_hash provenance without exposing secrets.
Old R2 remains FAIL and R3 remains unrun until a new PNG ingress is requested.
stop_conditions: Any hash comparison trusts a non-stored field or shortened hash.
